label: The Testament of Dan Concerning Anger and Lying. — Translator and historical edition notes
context: The Testament of Dan Concerning Anger and Lying.

blocks.text: [^testaments-twelve-patriarchs-iii-ix-2]: The reading of the Ox. ms. , μῂ κινεῖσθε is to be taken.
[^testaments-twelve-patriarchs-iii-ix-3]: Cam. ms. εις εἰδέαν ; Ox. ms. εἰς ἀηδίαν .
[^testaments-twelve-patriarchs-iii-ix-5]: The Ox. ms. omits from here to τοῖς ἔθνεσι Σωτήρ in c. 6.
[^testaments-twelve-patriarchs-iii-ix-6]: ᾽Εκπορεύοντες may be an error for ἐκπορνεύοντες , which Grabe wrongly gives as the reading of the Cam. ms.
[^testaments-twelve-patriarchs-iii-ix-9]: [Here is the Chiliasm of Barnabas, vol. i. p. 146.]
[^testaments-twelve-patriarchs-iii-ix-10]: [That is, not with the glory of His throne above.]
[^testaments-twelve-patriarchs-iii-ix-11]: Cf. Dorner, Doctrine of the Person of Christ , Introd., p, 15, Eng. transl.
